messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — SEV2 nccl collective ghosting detected on cluster-gpu-tp4 (rendezvous stalls, tasks stuck). Bridge: https://call.example/rdw-bridge/abc123
oncall-ryan: ACK I'm on it. joining bridge. starting basic triage: which job ids?
eng-ml-jess: Noted. affected job ids: 78234,78235,78236 (tp4 pipeline). Logs show repeated communicator timeouts and one container OOM prior to hang.
eng-ml-jess: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17 14:02:11] NCCL WARN: Rendezvous timed out (slot 3)
[2026-03-17 14:02:12] NCCL ERROR: unexpected msg from rank 2
[2026-03-17 14:02:13] Process 2 exited with status 137 (OOM)
```
infra-sam: I see node gpu-node-17 reported `Xid 79` in dmesg around the same time — driver reset. Could be a kernel/driver flake or NVLINK fault. network looks OK.
eng-runtime-miguel: If dmesg has Xid79, communicator state will be inconsistent leading to ghosting. Short-term: we can force-fail the tasks and fallback to single-GPU variants; long-term: need cleaner reconnect logic.
sre-ana: I'm cordoning gpu-node-17 and starting a drain. `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 && kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will move pods to other nodes.
eng-ml-jess: Can we pin to a compatible model variant while nodes recycle? Recommend routing traffic to `model-v2-small` (single-GPU) for customer-facing endpoints.
oncall-ryan: Executing traffic shift now: patching route table to prefer fallback pool. Will monitor QPS and latency.
pm-maya: @cs-lee any visible customer errors/alerts? need count and SLAs affected.
cs-lee: Customer impact: 8 customers had active inference requests; 3 saw request failures (HTTP 500 / timeout). Estimated affected queries ~1.2k over 12 minutes. Notifying highest-touch accounts.
infra-sam: Node network logs show a transient NVLINK negotiation error before Xid79 — marking hardware for EOE and re-provision.
sre-ana: Drain completed on gpu-node-17, pods evicted. Restarted communicator sidecars on replacement nodes. Health checks: 6/6 worker pods reconnected.
eng-runtime-miguel: Restarted nccl communicator service on the cluster, bumped rendezvous timeout from 30s -> 60s as a temporary mitigation.
eng-ml-jess: After fallback and restart, jobs resumed in single-GPU config; no further hangs observed for the affected job ids.
oncall-ryan: Bridge update: mitigation applied at 14:21 UTC. customers routed to fallback; node cordoned for repro and EOE.
pm-maya: Impact summary for incident report: 12-minute partial outage window, ~1.2k failed requests, 3 customers with errors, no data exfiltration. We'll schedule postmortem.
eng-ml-jess: Action items: 1) postmortem w/ root cause (driver Xid79) 2) add auto-failover to fallback variants 3) add alert for early Xid driver resets 4) HW ticket for node replacement.
cs-lee: I've emailed affected customers and opened support tickets for the 3 customers; committed to follow-up postmortem.
oncall-ryan: Closing bridge in 10m unless new symptoms. Leaving monitoring alerts on for 24h.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status=mitigated, severity=SEV2 -> monitoring. Incident ticket: INC-2026-847
sre-ana: Marking incident as handled for oncall rotation handoff. I'll take postmortem lead. Please add any more logs to the ticket.
eng-runtime-miguel: Note for postmortem: collect `dmesg`, `kubectl describe` for the evicted pods, and NCCL env/logs (NCCL_DEBUG=INFO).
pm-maya: Thanks team. follow-up scheduled: 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC postmortem review.
cs-lee: closing customer notifications after postmortem.
oncall-ryan: ACK. handing back to normal ops. :white_check_mark:
